brstu.title_block_policy: Use BrSTU/ESKD-style A1 frame and title block; apply GOST 19.701-90 as the binding flowchart-symbol standard.

passes: All nodes declare legal GOST types, bbox, side rules and machine I/O constraints.
Single Start/End, deleted elements, no database-symbol nodes, graph connectivity and trunk-axis policy checked.
Decision blocks have one input and labeled alternative outputs.
Edges declare ports, flow kind and orthogonal route points.
Connector count and grouped same-letter C continuation policy checked.
No predefined-process/function-block shapes or separate subflow drawings remain.
Drawio file is a single-page main drawing.
Title block uses the thesis content-page lower-table proportions, 185mm x 40mm size, lower-right frame alignment, and checked thick/thin grid strokes.
Bottom return-lane arrows are generated, open, horizontal, and positioned just right of their branch merge points.
Drawio nodes and title block match model bboxes, GOST shape styles, frame margins, aspect ratios and text-fit estimates.
Edges connect to declared centered ports, labels exist and line segments avoid symbols.
Line crossing and same-lane overlap checks executed; any crossing or hidden overlap is reported.
Required horizontal and vertical chain alignment checks executed.
Merge groups use visible connector stems, horizontal merge lane and one centered incoming line.
Branch groups are controlled GOST 4.3.1 tee branches from a centerline; visual columns are balanced left/right, bottom-aligned and internally uniform.
Display and document symbols are terminal outputs; arrows and dashed lines follow explicit line-style rules.
